settings.eyebrow: Chili Runner Food Truck · Roaming the metro since 2016
settings.headline: Chili that chases you.
settings.copy: Chili Runner rolls into a new corner every day with a menu built from scratch in the truck's tiny kitchen — slow-simmered chili, smoky birria, loaded fries, and hand-pressed tortillas. Follow the tracker. Catch us before the pot runs dry.

trust_list.text: Scratch-made daily from a real kitchen on wheels
Live tracker — we post our corner every morning
Cash, cards, and mobile pay all welcome

settings.title: Small kitchen,
settings.intro: Seven years on the road, one stubborn rule: everything worth eating is made in-house, from scratch, in the back of a truck.

stats.label: Bowls served since we rolled out in 2016
Metro corners on the weekly rotation
Hours on average until the chili's gone

settings.title: Made today,
settings.intro: A tight menu done right. When the pot's empty, it's empty — that's the point. Here's what's on the board when we roll up.

items.name: Signature Chili Bowl
items.description: Slow-simmered beef & bean chili, cheddar, crema, pickled onion, warm tortilla.

items.name: Birria Quesadilla
items.description: Shredded birria, Oaxaca cheese, consommé for dipping.

items.name: Loaded Street Fries
items.description: Crispy fries, chili, cheese sauce, jalapeño, crema drizzle.

items.name: Elote Cup
items.description: Grilled corn, cotija, chipotle mayo, lime, tajín.

items.name: Hand-Pressed Tortas
items.description: Slow-braised meat or veg, avocado, house slaw, on pressed bolillo.

items.name: Aguas Frescas
items.description: Fresh-pressed watermelon or horchata, made to order.

settings.title: Lakeside Farmers Market
settings.expired_text: Tonight's stop has wrapped — follow the tracker to see where the Chili Runner parks tomorrow.

settings.title: Catch us
settings.intro: No fixed address, no problem. Here's how to find the truck wherever it lands.

steps.title: Follow the tracker
steps.text: We post our corner and arrival time on socials every morning, rain or shine. Follow to know exactly where we'll be.

steps.title: Order at the window
steps.text: No apps, no kiosks — just a friendly window. Tell us what looks good; we'll fire it up fresh.

steps.title: Grab a spot
steps.text: Fold-out tables and a couple of stools around the truck. Eat hot, meet neighbors, stay a while.

steps.title: Catch us next time
steps.text: The menu changes with the seasons and the pot runs dry most days. Missed it? We'll be somewhere new tomorrow.

settings.note: First-time regulars get a loyalty card — buy nine bowls, the tenth is on the house.

settings.title: Street food,
settings.intro: We could cut corners and sell more. We don't. Here's what we refuse to compromise on.

features.title: Scratch, always
features.text: Chili simmers overnight, tortillas are pressed to order, sauces are built in-house. Nothing comes out of a bag.

features.title: Real ingredients
features.text: We buy from local farms and markets, and it shows up in the flavor. Seasonal menus mean we cook what's good right now.

features.title: Honest portions
features.text: A full bowl at a fair price, made for people who are actually hungry — not a photo prop.

features.title: Community corners
features.text: We park where neighborhoods gather — markets, parks, breweries — and tip the crew that feeds the regulars.

features.title: Fast, friendly window
features.text: Order at the window, eat in minutes. Real people, real conversation, real food.

features.title: We show up
features.text: Rain, cold, or heat wave — if we said we'd be there, we're there. The tracker is a promise.
features.detail: We run the route we post

settings.title: What regulars
settings.intro: The best review we get is seeing the same faces at a new corner. Here's what a few of them have told us.

reviews.quote: I've followed the Chili Runner to three different corners this month. The birria quesadilla is worth the drive — and the tracker makes it too easy to find them.
reviews.author: Dana P.

reviews.quote: As a lifelong chili snob, I was skeptical of a bowl from a truck. Now I've got a loyalty card. That slow-simmered chili is the real deal, every time.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: They showed up at our brewery every Friday all summer, rain and shine. The loaded fries and the crew's energy made it the best part of the week.
reviews.author: Elena V.

settings.title: Come hungry,
settings.intro: Want the truck at your event, office, or block party? Send a note. Want tonight's chili? Just check the tracker and roll up.
